narrative.overview:
Shiori is a careful record book kept by one reader. Every page is a sheet of accounts: what was read, what will change, what was written, what is worth reading next. Tables, figures and diffs are set plainly on cool paper in dark ink, with hairlines doing the work that boxes and shadows do elsewhere. Color appears only where it carries meaning: the one ribbon-teal accent for the action and the place you're at, and a small set of status washes that say whether a row is safe, flagged or failed.

The ledger is quiet but warm. The working screens (Sync, Matches, Stats, Settings) are plain and exact, because the user approves real writes from them. Where the app turns to reading for pleasure (cover grids, series pages, the Ask chat, ranking), the same system is allowed softer corners, larger covers and a gentler rhythm, so the covers carry the warmth instead of decoration. The ribbon bookmark in the header (the "shiori") is the one emblem.

Density is moderate: a single reading column up to 76rem, sections separated by space and hairlines, with Discover allowed the full window. Light and dark themes are equal citizens; dark redefines tokens only.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper-and-ink neutrals with a slight blue bias; one teal accent.
Flat: depth comes from hairlines and a shaded sheet, never shadows.
System font stack, compact sizes, tabular numbers for every figure.
Covers are the imagery; nothing decorative is added around them.
State is shown with small washes and badges, not large colored areas.

rules.name: The One Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Ribbon Teal is the only accent. It marks the action to take and where you are, and nothing else; never use it for decoration, large fills or headings.

rules.name: The Small Wash Rule
rules.body: Status color lives in badges, notices, row tints and thin borders. A whole panel or page is never painted in a status color.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Dark mode redefines the same custom properties; components never branch on theme.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every count, chapter number, score and date uses tabular numerals and doesn't wrap.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels, no letter-spaced caps, no display sizes outside series titles and the Ask empty state.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, use a 1px hairline or a shade step, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Ribbon Teal for the primary action, the current place and focus; one solid button per screen area.
Do separate sections with space and hairlines; use a bordered Sheet only for real objects (tables, charts, cards).
Do use tabular numerals for every number, and show status with a badge or wash.
Do let covers be the imagery, at 2:3 with small rounded corners and a Sheet Shade placeholder.
Do make grids and charts fill the width (auto-fit columns, equal-width chart slots).
Do define every color as a token on :root and redefine it for dark mode; respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, gradients or glows; the system is flat.
Don't introduce a second accent, a second typeface, or uppercase letter-spaced labels.
Don't fill panels, headers or buttons with a status color; a destructive button stays outlined.
Don't wrap every number in its own card; use the figures strip.
Don't add decorative illustration, icons for their own sake, or ornament around covers.
